The following events took place in '''29 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]'''.

==Events==
*Deaths of [[Hohass Ekwesh|Hohass "Runt" Ekwesh]] and [[Estoric Sandskimmer]] on [[Chashima]].<ref name="Mercy Kill">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>
*The [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar|claimed]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
*The [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] ended.
*[[Death/Legends|Death]] of [[Shimrra Jamaane]] and [[Onimi]], the true [[Supreme Overlord]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].
*The planet [[Denon/Legends|Denon]] became the temporary [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] capital while Coruscant is being rebuilt by the Galactic Alliance and the Yuuzhan Vong.
*[[Conclave on Zonama Sekot]].
*The [[Yuuzhan Vong empire]] and presumably the [[Peace Brigade]] were disbanded.
*[[RePlanetHab]] was formed as a corrupt organization against the refugees of the Yuuzhan Vong War in the galaxy along with many others.
